name: Building Permits
description: Information about development services permits such as building commercial, residential and signs. See also https://citydata.mesaaz.gov/Development-Services/Building-Permits/2gkz-7z4f. Included: All building permits applied. Not Included: Applications for Documents or Services, Code Compliance Complaints, Planning Cases, or Engineering Projects. It is assumed that all permits have been issued based on meeting all building and zoning codes.
